blocks.text: Government Road homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Government Road, September 2026. Detached houses: 24 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —. Condos and townhomes: 23 listed at month end and 3 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 5 over 4 months against an average of 27.0 listed, about 21.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 3 sold. condos and townhomes sold 20 over 4 months against an average of 24.5 listed, about 4.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 7 sold.
